verdict.rationale: Sandboxing is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only approval controls: write commands ask once per session, destructive commands always ask, and a full-permissions toggle. These are permission prompts, an adjacent control, not isolation of code execution, tools, or network access. Nothing in the pack documents a sandbox.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
